name: 二叉搜索树
description: 实现 BST：insert/search/inorder/delete，含删除各种节点场景

files.test_bst.py:
from bst import BST


def test_insert_and_inorder():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4, 6, 8]:
        tree.insert(v)
    # 中序遍历应是升序
    assert tree.inorder() == [1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]


def test_search():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4]:
        tree.insert(v)
    assert tree.search(5) is True
    assert tree.search(3) is True
    assert tree.search(4) is True
    assert tree.search(99) is False


def test_search_empty():
    tree = BST()
    assert tree.search(1) is False


def test_delete_leaf():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7]:
        tree.insert(v)
    tree.delete(3)  # 叶子节点
    assert tree.inorder() == [5, 7]
    assert tree.search(3) is False


def test_delete_node_with_one_child():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 8]:
        tree.insert(v)
    tree.delete(7)  # 只有一个右子节点 8
    assert tree.inorder() == [3, 5, 8]


def test_delete_node_with_two_children():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7, 1, 4, 6, 8]:
        tree.insert(v)
    tree.delete(5)  # 根节点，有两个子节点
    # 删除后仍应是有效 BST
    result = tree.inorder()
    assert result == [1, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8]


def test_delete_root():
    tree = BST()
    tree.insert(5)
    tree.delete(5)
    assert tree.inorder() == []


def test_delete_nonexistent():
    tree = BST()
    for v in [5, 3, 7]:
        tree.insert(v)
    tree.delete(99)
    assert tree.inorder() == [3, 5, 7]


def test_duplicate_insert():
    tree = BST()
    tree.insert(5)
    tree.insert(5)  # 重复插入
    # 实现决定行为，但不应崩溃；inorder 至少含一个 5
    assert 5 in tree.inorder()


def test_inorder_empty():
    tree = BST()
    assert tree.inorder() == []
